settings.description_override: The Camille is made for a day that takes the scenic route. Sturdy canvas, contrasting trim and a familiar boat-tote silhouette feel at home at the market, by the water or beside your desk. Easy to dress around and full of character, it is the bag that becomes part of your routine.
settings.fact_detail: Made by artisans with 10 years of experience

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: The Camille pairs an open-top canvas body with long handles, front bands and a belted detail. Approximate dimensions are 20 × 14 × 8 inches (W × H × D), with an approximately 10-inch handle drop. Construction varies between two-tone and solid colorways.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Spot-clean the canvas with a soft, barely damp cloth and mild soap where needed. Avoid soaking the trim or hardware. Air-dry fully away from direct heat and store upright in a cool, dry place.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
